Main.lean.plain_english_summary: The top-level proof driver of the formalization. Imports Statements.lean and New/Main.lean, and exports the five unconditional headline theorems: Mathlib's RiemannHypothesis, explicit zero-line localization for riemannZeta, half-plane nonvanishing for all Dirichlet L-functions on Re(s) > 1/2 (away from s = 1 for the trivial character), and GRH for arbitrary and primitive Dirichlet characters.

key_exports.name: riemannHypothesis
key_exports.summary: Proves Mathlib's canonical RiemannHypothesis statement via New.zeta_zeros_on_line New.grh.

key_exports.name: riemannZeta_eq_zero_re
key_exports.summary: Proves every nontrivial zero s != 1 of riemannZeta has Re(s) = 1/2.

key_exports.name: LFunction_ne_zero_of_half_lt_re
key_exports.summary: Proves L(chi, s) != 0 whenever Re(s) > 1/2 (except chi = 1, s = 1) directly via New.grh.

key_exports.name: LFunction_eq_zero_re
key_exports.summary: Proves every zero of any Dirichlet L-function in 0 < Re(s) < 1 has Re(s) = 1/2 via New.zeros_on_line New.grh.

key_exports.name: LFunction_eq_zero_re_of_isPrimitive
key_exports.summary: Specializes LFunction_eq_zero_re to primitive Dirichlet characters.

Statements.lean.plain_english_summary: Defines the four standalone target propositions imported by Main.lean over Mathlib alone (without Lib/Speed.lean or New/): explicit critical-line statements for riemannZeta and arbitrary/primitive Dirichlet L-functions, plus half-plane nonvanishing for Re(s) > 1/2.

key_exports.name: RiemannZetaZerosOnLine
key_exports.summary: Proposition that every zero of riemannZeta outside {-2, -4, ...} and {1} satisfies Re(s) = 1/2.

key_exports.name: DirichletLNonvanishingRightOfHalf
key_exports.summary: Proposition that L(chi, s) != 0 for all N >= 1, characters chi, and Re(s) > 1/2 (with chi != 1 or s != 1).

key_exports.name: DirichletLZerosOnLine
key_exports.summary: Proposition that all zeros of L(chi, s) with 0 < Re(s) < 1 satisfy Re(s) = 1/2.

key_exports.name: PrimitiveDirichletLZerosOnLine
key_exports.summary: Critical-line zero localization restricted to primitive Dirichlet characters.

New/Main.lean.plain_english_summary: Final analytic step reducing critical-line zero localization for Dirichlet L-functions and riemannZeta to half-plane nonvanishing DirichletLNonvanishingRightOfHalf (New.grh) via nonvanishing of Gamma factors on Re(s) > 0 and functional-equation symmetry s <-> 1 - s.

key_exports.name: New.zeros_on_line
key_exports.summary: Deduces DirichletLZerosOnLine from DirichletLNonvanishingRightOfHalf via gammaFactor_eq_zero_or_LFunction_one_sub_eq_zero.

key_exports.name: New.zeta_zeros_on_line
key_exports.summary: Deduces RiemannZetaZerosOnLine from DirichletLNonvanishingRightOfHalf via completedRiemannZeta_one_sub.
